text:
Ananya: Quick sync — we have a runtime patch ready that needs to go in today in the 15:30 PT release corridor. Who can own the deploy and smoke validation?
Kevin: I can take the deploy slot. ETA for me to be on call: 15:15 PT.
Molly: I'll do the smoke validation and metrics check.
Ananya: Awesome. Kevin, can you confirm you can execute rollback within 10 minutes if perf regressions show up?
Kevin: Yep. I have the rollback playbook ready. Command is:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime-server -n prod --to-revision=3
```
Sara: I'll watch traces and tracing dashboard, can jump if we see sampling spikes.
deploy-bot: @Ananya Deployment window reserved: 15:30-15:45 PT for team/runtime by Kevin. Reminder: drain and drain-check required before traffic shift.
Tim: Heads up — there's a batch job scheduled at 15:40 that could add noise to latency. Can we shift to 15:50 if that's a concern?
Molly: 15:50 is fine for me. Any objections?
Ananya: Slight preference for earlier due to calendar constraints. Kevin, ok to keep 15:30 and watch batch?
Kevin: I can keep 15:30 if we soft-stop the batch for 10m. @Tim can you hold the job at 15:40?
Tim: I can gate it. Will hold via the job controller flag.
Molly: Smoke checklist (I'll run through):
- sanity API (200s)
- p50/p99 token latency baseline check
- error spike check (5m window)
- quick end-to-end sample from prod flow
I'll post results in thread.
Ananya: Perfect. Also can we add a canary target (10% traffic) for initial 5 minutes then scale to 100% if green?
Kevin: Yes — will deploy canary and apply traffic-split rule. Canary knob: `traffic-split canary=10`
deploy-bot: Canary deployment initiated at 15:30 PT. Canary instance: runtime-canary-42.
Molly: Starting baseline checks now (15:32 PT). I'll report p50/p99 after 2 minutes.
Molly: p50 +2ms vs baseline, p99 +18ms (within alert threshold). No errors.
Sara: Traces look normal. No new service hotspots.
Molly: E2E sampling passed for 5 samples. Ready to promote.
Kevin: Promoting to 100% traffic now.
deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to runtime-v2 at 15:38 PT.
Tim: Batch job unblocked at 15:40, monitoring for any correlation.
Molly: Post-promote checks: error rate steady, latency steady. Logging shows one transient 500 from a downstream but retried and succeeded.
Ananya: Thanks team. Kevin, keep rollback command at hand for the next 20 minutes. If anything pops, call it.
Kevin: Acknowledged. I'll ping here if I need to roll back.
Molly: Will run an expanded perf scan at +30m and post results.
Sara: I'll add a note to the incident log that this was a routine deploy and passed canary.
Ananya: Great. Marking this as complete unless someone sees an issue. :thumbsup:
Molly: All good from my side.
Kevin: Closing the release corridor.
deploy-bot: Deployment success: runtime-v2 promoted at 15:38 PT. No rollback performed. Audit ID: dep-2026-1732109876
Ananya: Thanks everyone!
